summary: BitTorrent completed its first revenue-funded quarterly buyback-and-burn on 17 Oct, removing ~21.6T BTT (about 2.18% of supply) on TRON. That is a dated supply event. Buzz is up ~1.5x its 3-day norm but the price has barely moved (+0.5% 24h), so this is not chasing a pump. Mildly positive.
catalyst_note: First revenue-funded buyback-and-burn, ~2.18% of supply, 17 Oct
